purpose: Defines forge-specific policies for authoring Claude Code SKILLs, custom agents and user questions, supplementing the generic authoring guide.
summary: Policy on verifying official Claude Code specs via meta references
SKILL execution model: inheritance type only, no context: fork or agent
Isolated-context processing implemented as custom agents
Inherited SKILL must state it only does its own task
Custom agent additions need design rationale and Role constraint tests
User questions must use AskUserQuestion, not plain text
Exception for discussion-driven SKILLs with declared boundaries
Do not block AskUserQuestion via disallowed-tools
SKILL.md descriptions are written in Japanese
tasks: Writing user confirmation steps in a SKILL
